d:
Amritpal Singh is set to return to Punjab for just three hours on November 21, 2026, to attend the last rites of his grandmother, Charan Kaur. But what appears to be a family-related visit has turned into a major security and political challenge for the Punjab government.
Currently lodged in Dibrugarh Jail in Assam, the Khadoor Sahib MP will travel thousands of kilometres under tight police security. The Punjab Police is preparing an elaborate security arrangement, with strict court-imposed conditions governing his visit to his native village, Jallupur Khera.
